observations: Photo 0: White Xbox One console with two controllers — one white, one blue — placed on top. The console has a perforated front panel and the Xbox logo visible on the front right.
Photo 1: Same console from a slightly different angle, showing the front with the disc slot and ports. The blue controller is in front, white behind. Watermark 'KINGSPLEN GAMING GADGETS' is visible.
Photo 2: Side view of the console with both controllers on top. The blue controller is on the left, white on the right. The perforated front panel is visible. Watermark present.
All photos show the console and controllers in good physical condition with no visible damage or wear.
The console appears to be a standard white Xbox One model, not the newer Xbox Series X or S.
The controllers appear to be standard Xbox controllers, not custom or third-party.

identity.kind: Xbox One console with two controllers

claims.claim: Neatly Uk Used Xbox One available
claims.evidence: The console appears clean and undamaged, but there is no visible proof of origin (UK) or usage history. The term 'neatly' is subjective and not verifiable from photos.
Photo 0, 1, and 2 show two controllers (one white, one blue) placed on top of the console.
All photos show no visible damage to the console or controllers. The surface is clean and undamaged.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game or menu.

risks.risk: Controllers may not function properly or may be non-genuine
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs (e.g., button presses, stick movement).

risks.risk: FC26 package may be missing or not included
risks.proof: Photo of the FC26 package (e.g., game disc, manual, or accessories) alongside the console and controllers.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number on the back of the console and a verification check via Xbox or Nigerian gaming platform.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially blacklisted or stolen

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and functioning.
Photo of the FC26 package (game disc, manual, etc.).
Photo of the serial number on the back of the console.
Proof of origin (e.g., receipt, UK warranty card, or seller's documentation).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
